column3: Subject to the provisions of this Act and any other

column2: written law, the Centre shall have the power—

column3: to  accept  and  receive  books,  documents,  files,
photographs,  films,  disks,  audio  and  video  tapes,
significant  personal  belongings  and  souvenirs  of
the  childhood  and  youth  of  late  Pandith  W.  D.
Amaradeva,  his  creations  and  collections  with
personal interest, official portraits, grants, awards
and gifts received by him to be deposited, and to
take all measures to secure, archive, administer and
exhibit  those  instruments;
to purchase, lease and rent, lands or buildings which
may be required for the purposes of the Centre and
to transfer, sell or exchange of the same as may be
deemed  expedient  with  a  view  to  promoting  the
objects of the Centre;
to construct and renovate any building required for
the objects specified herein;
to borrow or raise funds with or without securities
and to receive grants, gifts or donations in cash or
kind:
